title: Creating and Managing Tags for Azure Resources

blocks.text: Tags are key-value pairs that allow you to organize resources in Azure. You can configure and manage Azure tags directly from the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal for resources that are deployed by Zscaler Deception. You can create the following types of tags from the Deception Admin Portal:

blocks.item: Decoy tags: Added to decoy resources such as user decoys, managed identity decoys, and app service decoys.
Management tags: Added to all other resources.

blocks.text: Zscaler recommends configuring Azure tags in the Deception Admin Portal before setting up the integration with Azure, as these tags are only added to resources when creating them in the Azure cloud.

blocks.item: In the Deception Admin Portal, go to Deceive > Cloud Deception > Azure > Settings.
Locate the Azure account for which you want to configure tags, and click the Edit icon.
In the Azure Account Setting window, click Tags.
See image.
The Add Tags window appears.
In the Add Tags window:
To add a decoy tag:
Under the Decoy Tags section, click Add Tag.
Enter the key and value pair for the tag.
To add a management tag:
Under the Management Tags section, click Add Tag.
Enter the key and value pair for the tag.
Do not use words or phrases such as decoy, deception, and active defense, etc. for the key and value pairs, as they can provide a hint to adversaries about the nature of decoy resources.
See image.
Click Save.

Tags are applied while creating and deploying new resources via the deployment script. New tags are not applied to existing decoys. If you want to apply new tags to all decoys, then you must delete all decoys and deploy them again.
Go to Deceive > Cloud Deception > Azure > Settings.
Locate the Azure account for which you want to edit tags, and click the Edit icon.
In the Azure Account Setting window, click Tags.
See image.
The Add Tags window appears.
In the Add Tags window:
Under the Decoy Tags section, modify the key and value pair for the decoy tag that you want to edit.
Under the Management Tags section, modify the key and value pair for the management tag that you want to edit.
See image.
Click Save.

Modified decoy tags are not applied to existing decoy resources; they are only applied to the new decoy resources that are created after editing the tag. Existing decoy resources retain the old tags. If you want to apply modified tags to all decoys, then you must delete all decoys and deploy them again.
Modified management tags are applied to existing management resources created by Deception in Azure during the integration when any operation is subsequently performed via deployment script.
Go to Deceive > Cloud Deception > Azure > Settings.
Locate the Azure account for which you want to delete tags, and click the Edit icon.
In the Azure Account Setting window, click Tags.
See image.
The Add Tags window appears.
In the Add Tags window:
Under the Decoy Tags section, click the Delete icon for the decoy tag.
Under the Management Tags section, click the Delete icon for the management tag.
See image.
Click Save.

blocks.text: Deleting tags prevents further usage of them. Existing resources are not affected as the tags are not removed from them.
